title: Calculating the Credit Allowed for Hours a Micro Market Kiosk Could Not Take a Payment
content:
Where a client of the Unattended Micro Market Program claims for the hours its kiosk could not take a payment, the credit allowed is the chargeable hours at the credit rate, applied to the settlement charged on the agreement over the two months to the day the credit is worked out, together with the empty-market step on that same settlement, the two figures being added before the allowed share is taken of them, and the whole held to the ceiling on credits in one settlement period printed against the market format.

The figure the chargeable hours earn at the credit rate, the empty-market step, the figure those two make when added and taken at the allowed share, the ceiling on credits in one settlement period and the credit allowed are each rounded to the nearest cent as they are taken, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. The credit is recorded against the kiosk whose lost hours it answers.

## The quantities

The hours are read from the kiosk outage requests approved on the agreement, each approved request standing for one hour the kiosk could not take a payment, and they are read over the three months to the day the credit is worked out. The chargeable hours are the hours so read, halved and rounded down to a whole hour.

The credit rate is the percentage of the settlement printed against the market format. No empty-market step is credited. The allowed share is the full allowance share of 100 per cent.

## A claim worked through

*Hypothetical inputs.* The settlement charged on the agreement over the two months to the working day totals 6000.00 USD. Seven kiosk outage requests stand approved on the agreement over the three months to that day. The market format prints a credit of 1 per cent of the settlement for each hour and a ceiling on credits in one settlement period of 20 per cent of that settlement.

The hours read are 7. Halved they are three and a half, and rounded down to a whole hour the chargeable hours are 3. At 1 per cent of 6000.00 USD for each of those 3 hours, the figure is 180.00 USD. The empty-market step is nothing. The two added give 180.00 USD, of which the allowed share of 100 per cent is 180.00 USD. The ceiling on credits in the period is 1200.00 USD, being 20 per cent of 6000.00 USD, so the credit allowed is 180.00 USD.

*Hypothetical inputs, second case.* Were the same market to have carried 60 approved kiosk outage requests, the chargeable hours would be 30 and the figure 1800.00 USD; the ceiling of 1200.00 USD would then govern and 1200.00 USD would be allowed.
